design_boundary: 除证据摘录所锁外观之外，机位、材质细化、具体比例、自然解剖细节及环境布置为美术推断，不新增原著事实、不沿用游戏id转数。
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW 《问真》 Gu portrait collectible card, exact 5:7. Reference image ONLY supplies fine silver double-line rounded-corner frame with restrained curled corners and physical fantasy realism, not its creature, body, color, background or floor. One fully visible specific subject approximately 55-65% card width; clear subject hierarchy, physical sidelight, realistic textures, restful dreamlike space, complete frame on all sides. No text, title, number, rank, watermark, people, hands, halo, gratuitous gems or decorative symbols. Subject: ONE grey-white TADPOLE-shaped living Gu, fist-sized canonical, freshly refined healthy floating state. Round but not huge balloon-like head/body transitions smoothly into a single thin gracefully tapering tadpole tail with a subtle flexible membrane edge. Calm understated biological detail, tiny unexpressive dark eyes if visible, no smiling face, no fish paired fins, no legs, limbs, wings or eel-sized coils. Opaque milky grey-white organic skin, moist satin surface, tiny natural surface variations and slight subsurface translucency on tail edges, not papery centipede, jade, marble, ghost mist or jelly crystal. Tail forms one loose gentle upward bend in air, entire creature readable in oblique side view, clear round body and thin tail silhouette. Hover above a low-contrast dark warm grey EARTHY plane far below out of focus, background softly graded blue-grey neutral air, no water aquarium or hand. Physically plausible soft side/back lighting separates skin and tail thickness, creature suspended without streaks or aura. No halos, blue soul flames, skulls, human souls or magical bath ritual. A quiet uncanny real-world-like impossible tadpole in air.
